name: Lingering Essence shortens the owned Vampyr's Kiss rank from periodic damage (#647, #9472)
contract: Lingering Essence 680695's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Lingering Essence 680824, a single SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN with BasePoints -1001 and MiscValue 504275, rank 1 of Vampyr's Kiss. The tooltip is 'Periodic damage and healing done now has a $h% chance to reduce the cooldown of Vampyr's Kiss by $/1000;680824s1 sec' and the record's own ProcChance is 50. A level-80 Bloodmage casts the owned rank 504281, whose cooldown is the one the player sees and Spell::CheckCast enforces, so the reduction must reach 504281, not only rank 1. A control Bloodmage without Lingering Essence casts 504281 immediately afterwards and carries a cooldown at least as long; the tester's 504281 can only fall below it through the procs. Crimson Tide is cast as rank 504134, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h. Its single effect is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with Amplitude 3000, DurationIndex 8 (15 s) and MaxAffectedTargets 10, so one cast against seven dummies produces 5 ticks x 7 targets = 35 separate PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC events, and two casts 15 s apart produce about 70. At 50% per event the chance that none of roughly 70 events procs is beyond astronomical, so the real proc chance is left untouched.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The control has no Lingering Essence
Vampyr's Kiss is on its full category cooldown
Five ticks on every dummy in range
The control's remaining Vampyr's Kiss cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: the procs cut the owned Vampyr's Kiss rank below the control's
